place.source_title: Red clock-topped information kiosk on the pier (Navy Pier)

brief: A pier kiosk: a red clock-topped information kiosk on the pier (Navy Pier); a tiny booth with a serving hatch. One photo. Piles carried 10 m below the modelled bed (spec rule 4).

facade.notes: Navy Pier's 1995 information kiosk: a red open-sided pavilion with a flared pyramidal green roof, a clock in the gable, carved brackets and a 'Directory' board; fanciful red-and-yellow pavilions along a crowded promenade, the Chicago skyline across the water

why.note: pier kiosks: the smallest rentable unit, a booth per boat line or vendor, placed along the promenade flow
the 1990s festival-marketplace look (Rouse): bright, playful, toy-like kiosks
